ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. The maximum feasible cross-legal-order generality is profile-parametricity: every trusted mechanism (admission, provenance, replay, certificates, structural validation, citation grammar, deontic classification) is a single function parameterized by a hash-committed legal-order PROFILE supplied as data (article ranges, gazette/publisher identity and key material, language/script normalization, calendar, citation grammar, deontic lexicon), with a noninterference guarantee that no trusted decision depends on any jurisdiction fact except through the profile parameter; any legal order lacking a committed well-formed profile yields typed UNKNOWN (H2), never a guess. No feasible system can exceed this: mechanism-level universality is attainable, semantic-level universality is not — there exists no jurisdiction-free formal semantics of law, so content decisions are necessarily relative to the profile's committed model.
derivation: Information-theoretic: a validator's output can carry no information about a jurisdiction's structure that was not supplied as input; if the information is not in the committed profile, a decision about it is fabrication, structurally forbidden by H2. Full generality = moving ALL jurisdiction information out of code into committed data; the ceiling on the code side is exactly parametricity/noninterference (two runs differing only in un-profiled jurisdiction facts produce identical outputs or both UNKNOWN). Model-dependence is irreducible: deontic and structural semantics differ across legal orders, so correctness for order J is only definable relative to a formal model of J — the profile schema IS that model, and an order inexpressible in the schema is honestly out of scope (UNKNOWN), the H2-optimal outcome. Verification: the profile must be hash-committed into the release chain, else a producer swaps jurisdiction rules undetected (H8).
relativity_note: Relative to the committed legal-order profile SCHEMA — a chosen formal structural model of a legal order (work/expression/manifestation identity + gazette-anchored publication events + per-profile citation and deontic grammars). Generality claims hold for exactly the class of legal orders expressible in the schema; anything outside it is typed UNKNOWN by construction. Cross-order composition (conflict-of-laws meta-rules over profiles) is a distinct mechanism family adjudicated in the closure's taxonomy (DIM-15 family addition), not a ceiling change here: choice-of-law rules are themselves codifiable as committed meta-rulebases over profiles, with UNKNOWN for uncodified renvoi — inside this ceiling's parametricity form. Witness instantiation: appendix.
lean_obligation: Model trusted decision procedures as D : Profile -> Input -> Outcome with Outcome := PASS | FAIL | UNKNOWN, well-formedness WF : Profile -> Prop, jurisdiction facts partitioned into profiled and unprofiled parts. Prove: (profile_noninterference) WF p and agreement on profiled facts imply D p x1 = D p x2; (honest_unknown) not WF p implies D p x = UNKNOWN; (profile_bound) admission implies the profile hash is offline-recomputable from the release chain; (composition) a conflict-of-laws meta-rulebase M over profiles p1..pk is itself a committed profile-level artifact, and D extended by M preserves noninterference w.r.t. the union of profiled facts.

attainment_witness_appendix.candidate_mechanism: B0's lower layers are already content-neutral (certificate schema, crypto/identity, Merkle/census/replay spine, ELI URI constructors). Steps: (1) define a profile .sexp schema and extract every jurisdiction constant into a Greece profile — the constants are localized and enumerable (greek-law-types.lisp registry, *constitution-articles* = 120 in structure.lisp, FEK issue tables, /exp/ell URI segment, el/en language assertion, revision calendar, the adapter's 1-9999 range); (2) hash the profile into the chained census and make it an admission input, so profile swap = new accountable transition (H6); (3) enforce parametricity structurally with a build gate: a jurisdiction literal in any trusted seat outside the single profile-loader seat fails the gate; (4) unknown jurisdiction: the loader returns typed UNKNOWN and downstream gates fail closed.
attainment_witness_appendix.b0_gap_hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: domain validation is Greece-coupled in code (hardcoded 120 articles, FEK identifiers, /exp/ell segment, language asserts, revision calendar, adapter range); the cross-order design exists only as an UNAPPROVED FROZEN proposal with no executable enforcement (per creator law it cannot self-activate); no profile schema, no profile commitment into the release chain, no parametricity gate exist today.
